description: PAYMENT_RETRY_COUNT renamed to PAYMENT_MAX_RETRIES. New code read old key, defaulted to 0, causing all failed payments to not retry. Elevated error rate detected after 3 minutes in canary.
user_impact: none — caught in canary before promotion

description: DB_TIMEOUT changed from milliseconds to seconds in new version. Code expected ms but env var was set in seconds. Result: 1ms effective timeout, all DB calls failed.
New STRIPE_API_VERSION env var required by v3 but not added to deployment config. Service started but all Stripe API calls returned 400 Bad Request.
